scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run --project "!@smg/server" && vitest run --project @smg/server src/ && vitest run --project @smg/server test/
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run packages/game-sdk packages/guess-engine packages/domain packages/application games/guess-the-number games/safecracker games/bomb-defusal games/seasonal-target games/mind-games games/registry --coverage --testTimeout=20000
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
